# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 47 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 39 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_047_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 47

**1** Jesus said: "No one can ride two horses at once or string two bows at once.

**2** No servant can serve two masters — you'd end up respecting one and slighting the other.

**3** Nobody who's just drunk old wine wants to switch to new wine right away.

**4** And you don't put new wine in old wineskins — they'd burst. And you don't put old wine in new wineskins — it would go bad.

**5** You don't sew an old patch on a new coat — it would just tear."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "At once" added to v.1 for clarity
- "You'd end up" — the servant saying rendered as direct address
- "Switch to new wine right away" — the preference rendered as a switching action
